KaTeX 0.16.22
=============

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/0.16.22

`katex.min.js` is copied unchanged from the official npm package after checking
the package's SHA-512 integrity. License: MIT; see LICENSE in this directory.

TraceScholar uses `output: 'mathml'` with `trust: false`, strict error handling,
bounded macro expansion and bounded size. No CDN, CSS or font download is needed;
the preview relies on native MathML in current browsers. Unsupported formulas
retain the source image and copyable LaTeX.
